2023-4068-4770-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-4068-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4247-5551.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-4247-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat from step 4.

862-3899-4053-6989.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

757-1446-4221-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1446-4221-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Viral Drake to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

276-533-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
276-533-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Angrath's Marauders.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3257-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3257-4231-6753.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6248-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6248-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

38-659-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-7296.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4742-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-1753-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3967-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1550-4251-6965.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-6965.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2198-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Deceiver Exarch.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3716-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
3716-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Fanning the Flames spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Repeat.
3716-4613-5643-6586.notes: Casting Fanning the Flames for {3}{R}{R} deals 0 damage. However, the Zombies will makes one more mana each time, so you can cast Fanning the Flames for more mana so long as you have mana available to deal damage. The mana cost assumes you've had only one Zombie enter the battlefield this turn. If you've had two enter, the cost becomes {4}{R}{R} instead. If you've had three or more enter, the cost becomes {3}{R}{R} instead.

1274-2999-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2999-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

647-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1690-2350-2364-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Stone Calendar.
1690-2350-2364-2538.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast a historic permanent by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2350-2364-2538.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2793-3743-4365-5089-5436.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4365-5089-5436.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

77-2438-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-2921-5687-5689.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3455-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Many Faces has a power of at least 2.
2713-3455-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vizier of Many Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vizier of Many Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vizier of Many Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

38-3705-4871-5465.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

997-2525-2947.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1753-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

678-2034-2060-2123-4017.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kokusho, adding {C}{C}.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

815-4191-4217.easyPrerequisites: There is an applicable target for Call to Heel.
815-4191-4217.description:
Cast Call to Heel by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Lutri without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Call to Heel.
Resolve the Call to Heel copy, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2249-3192-4214.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-3192-4214.description:
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the legendary creature.

804-1367-3039-4450.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Carth the Lion.
804-1367-3039-4450.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.

381-1456-2452-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Gravebane Zombie's power.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3146-3263-4279-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3146-3263-4279-4929.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {2} and discarding Voidwing Hybrid, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Voidwing Hybrid triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {2} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2034-2493-4872-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1392-2034-3129-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Goblin.
1392-2034-3129-4871.description:
Activate Weirding Shaman by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Weirding Shaman ability, creating four 1/1 Goblin Rogue creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin Rogue creature token, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin Rogue dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

15-1339-4050-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-1339-4050-4875.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

770-2499-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {3}{U}.
770-2499-3821.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Yarok.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {3}{U}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
When Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Yarokg, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.
